description: This file defines the ExecutorMetrics class and companion object, which track and manage executor and driver metrics in Apache Spark. It includes methods for retrieving, updating, and comparing metrics, as well as obtaining current metrics from the MemoryManager.

classes.name: ExecutorMetrics
classes.description: A class for tracking executor and driver metrics, with methods to access, compare, and update metric values.

methods.name: getMetricValue
methods.description: Returns the value for a specified metric by name.

methods.name: isSet
methods.description: Checks if the metrics have been initialized.

methods.name: compareAndUpdatePeakValues
methods.description: Compares current metrics with new metrics and updates peak values if higher.

methods.name: getCurrentMetrics
methods.description: Retrieves current executor metrics as an array of Longs using the MemoryManager.
